name: Jasai–Uran National Highway
significance: NH 348BB is a branch of NH 348. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Jasai to Uran, and it meets NH 348 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 348 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Panvel to Jasai
